channel.title: Matt Coffey Design Journal
channel.description: Master Blacksmith | Traverse City | 25+ years of master metalworking. Custom railings, furniture, and architectural art in Northern Michigan.

item.title: The Truth About Powder Coating vs. Traditional Patina Finishes
item.description: In architectural metalwork, the finish dictates the lifespan. Why we often argue against commercial powder coating in favor of deep-penetrating oil and chemical patinas.

item.title: Case Study: Engineering the Lake Leelanau Spiral Staircase
item.description: Engineering a floating three-story spiral staircase using one-inch solid mild steel, without visible welds.

item.title: Anatomy of an Anvil: Why I Still Use a 100-Year-Old Tool
item.description: Modern anvils lack the rebound and soul of forged-steel historic pieces. A deep dive into the Peter Wright anvil.

item.title: Hot-Rolled vs Cold-Rolled Steel in Architectural Metalwork
item.description: They look identical on a spreadsheet, but behave entirely differently at the forge. Which material is right for your home?

item.title: The Lost Art of Structural Riveting in Modern Metalwork
item.description: Before ARC and MIG welding, bridges and skyscrapers were pinned entirely by rivets. We bring this ancient joinery technique to modern residential designs.

item.title: Blacksmith vs. Welder: What's the Difference?
item.description: Understanding the distinction between blacksmiths and welders helps clients choose the right craftsman for their architectural metalwork project.

item.title: Wrought Iron vs. Cast Iron vs. Mild Steel: A Guide for Homeowners
item.description: Three materials, three distinct characteristics. Learn which metal is right for your railing, gate, or furniture project.
